xml_snippets.Title: DankPyon_AncientForest (BiomeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: Ancient Forest
xml_snippets.Description Originale: Flatland covered in lylses and scara trees—the ancient biome is an arid place of clear skies and bright green elven trees with autumn-stained flora. Although much of the land is fertile, the crowded botany makes large cities a challenge while hiding camps and homesteads. An abundance of animals gather towards ancient biomes thanks to the various hiding spots found in trees, large flora, and crevasses that lead to caves. Some may find the biomes unsettling, as howling night winds carry whispers of the old gods.

xml_snippets.Title: DankPyon_DarkForest (BiomeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: Dark Forest
xml_snippets.Description Originale: An ancient wilderness tall like no other, a place of dim light and dense, overwhelming vegetation. Commonly used to procure broad variety of cautionary tales for mischievous children. And justly so. Not many live long enough to carry this knowledge out of the forest, since the forest itself wishes to remain undiscovered. And it just so happens, this particular thicket has an arsenal of gnarly thorns and amply clawed paws willing to fulfill that wish.
